old_caption: The video begins with a clear plastic container mounted on a wooden stand, rotating within a transparent circular hoop. Inside the container, a white object is visible, moving as the container spins. A wooden stick is positioned horizontally, appearing to interact with the rotating container. A blue hose is attached to the base of the hoop. The background is plain and light-colored, keeping focus on the rotating container and the stick. The motion of the container and stick is continuous, with slight variations in position and angle.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a dark scene, gradually transitioning to reveal a clear plastic hamster wheel mounted on a wooden stand. Inside the wheel, a small white hamster is actively running, its movement creating a blur due to the speed. The wheel is connected to a blue hose, which extends outward from the wheel's base. A wooden stick is positioned horizontally above the wheel, seemingly interacting with it. As the hamster continues to run, the stick moves slightly, indicating some form of interaction or mechanism. The background remains plain and light-colored, keeping the focus on the hamster and the wheel. The video captures the dynamic motion of the hamster and the subtle interaction with the stick, emphasizing the activity within the wheel.
caption: A vertical wooden post with a metal hook on a white surface against a pale wall suspends a transparent cup holding a white cylinder. A clear tube attached to the cup bends into a large open loop around it, one arc colored blue, and a thin skewer projects from the cup. The hanging assembly is already in continuous motion, rotating and tilting about the hook. The cup's opening shifts from facing upper-right toward upright as the skewer sweeps from down-left to up-left. The tube loop cycles between a wide ellipse and a narrow edge-on profile, with the blue arc traveling around its perimeter. The white cylinder stays inside, changing apparent position as the cup tilts, while motion blur varies with the rotation speed. The post, hook and background remain fixed, so the movement belongs to the object.
